description: One HumanMirror tool for verified outcomes and canonical intent routing. Provide intent to route free to the correct HumanMirror safety, commerce, payment or best-execution boundary. Provide outcome_type/input for a directly verified Outcome; 6 Nexus credits are kept only on verified success.

contract_id.description: Optional Outcome contract ID returned by a dry run.

dispatch_only.description: When true, resolve the canonical HumanMirror route without charging Nexus credits.

dry_run.description: When true, return a free quote and do not reserve or consume credits.

input.description: JSON input for the requested result.

intent.description: Optional routing intent, for example sanitize untrusted input, protect an agent purchase, issue execution evidence, use the zero-cost sink, diagnose a payment failure, or request best execution.

objective.description: Natural-language measurable objective, for example: remove duplicate records and prove none remain.

outcome_type.description: Optional explicit Outcome type: clean_json, deduplicate_records, normalize_entity, data_quality_at_least, detect_anomalies, no_secrets, output_quality, schema_compatible, safe_preflight, execution_receipt.

route_intent.description: Alias for intent when the caller wants canonical route discovery.

name: humanmirror_do
